page_title: Sudowrite - Best AI Writing Partner for Fiction

sources.entry: Sudowrite - The model generates text by guessing what's most likely to come next, one word at a time. Kind of like autocomplete on your phone. #paid

summary.name: Sudowrite
summary.one_liner: Sudowrite is an AI writing tool for novelists that offers drafting, planning, revision, feedback and brainstorming features.
use_cases: Drafting a novel from an outline
Overcoming writer's block with next-passage suggestions
Brainstorming names, titles and plot twists
summary.what_it_does: The page describes a set of AI writing features for fiction: Write suggests the next 300 words based on characters, tone and plot, with options; Story Bible guides a project from idea to outline to chapters to full text; Expand builds out scenes that feel rushed; Rewrite offers revisions of sentences; Feedback gives five areas to improve. It also lists Describe, Canvas for plot and character planning, Brainstorm for names and titles, Visualize for generating art from character sheets, and a Chat mode. A plugins section mentions over 1,000 writing and feedback options, such as simulating readers or converting a novel to a screenplay. The writing app offers themes, dark modes and a focus mode.
notable: Story Bible for step-by-step novel drafting from idea to chapters
Write and Expand features that suggest or build out text in the author's voice
Plugins section with 1,000+ writing and feedback tools
caveats: Paid after free trial at $10/month; the page says no credit card is needed to start
Listing in the collection marks it as paid
Page is mostly marketing with testimonials; claims about quality are not independently verified
